Security-minded

Security & research

Security runs through my work: from research on cryptographic API misuse to tests for a forensic tool used by the Federal Police.

Research · CS thesis

Crypto-API misuse in Android apps

My thesis at UnB evaluated how third-party libraries affect cryptographic API misuse reports in Android projects: I ran static analyzers (CryptoGuard, CogniCrypt) over real apps and used library detection (LibScout, LibRadar) to separate the app's own misuses from those inside its dependencies.

  • Static analysis
  • Cryptography
  • Android
  • Python

Open source · Forensics · Java

IPED

The Brazilian Federal Police's digital forensics tool (3k+ stars). I wrote unit tests for its evidence parsers (RFC 822 email, P2P libraries) and its regex search, and fixed the bugs they uncovered.
